nodes.g: to cleave, slice
nodes.klein: to cleave, split. to plow, till the ground (from the second meaning derived the meaning ‘to serve the deity, worship’). he cleft, plowed (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ps. 141:7); he worshipped. was cleft, was split. he cleft open, sliced; (f.) she caused to cleave, gave birth to (said of an animal). was cleft, was split, was sliced; was plowed. was cleft, was split, was sliced.
